newsitem.title: ITALY: Employment in big Italy firms falls 3.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Employment in big Italy firms falls 3.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Employment in Italian industrial firms with more than 500 employees fell 3.5 percent year-on-year in November, the national statistics institute ISTAT said.
Its employment index for the sector stood at 75.2 (1988=100) in November, with month-on-month inflation down 0.3 percent from October.
For the January-November 1996 period, employment fell 1.9 percent over the same period in 1995, ISTAT said. Hours worked per employee fell 2.7 percent year-on-year.
The number of people put on temporary lay-off schemes rose 28.5 percent year-on-year.
ISTAT said the sectors most affected in November by the fall in employment were mining, metals and chemicals, metalworking, utilities, food textiles and manufacturing.
